problem: Held-out backscatter is a native EPSG:4326 grid, so x/y pixel spacings are anisotropic in metres.

solution.reference_location_rule: Use the exact midpoint of the frozen backscatter header bounds.
solution.patch_rule: For each frozen radius r, construct one fixed native-grid mask using d=sqrt((dc*dx_m)^2+(dr*dy_m)^2), disk d<=r, annulus 1.25r<d<=2r. Reuse the identical mask for every candidate and every control in that radius stratum.
solution.first_difference_rule: Preserve the established metric definition: median absolute native first differences between adjacent valid pixels whose pair lies within the physical disk mask; do not interpolate or resample values.

unchanged_v2.zero_mad_rule: exclude metric when same-radius eligible-control MAD is exactly zero
unchanged_v2.aggregate_score: 0.5*max(active positive robust z)+0.5*mean(active positive robust z)
